headline: Speed couldn’t believe the new tech in the iPhone 18 😂😂 Apple just announced the iPhone
body: Speed couldn’t believe the new tech in the iPhone 18 😂😂 Apple just announced the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. Same design language as last year’s Pros. New colors: black, silver, glacier, and burgundy. Smaller Dynamic Island. A20 Pro chip on 2nm. Apple says the GPU is up to 40% faster than A19 Pro and this is the longest battery life they’ve ever put in an iPhone. Pro Max is the biggest jump. The real camera change is the 48MP Fusion main with variable aperture , the first time Apple’s given that kind of control on an iPhone. Triple 48MP setup on the back. iOS 27. Storage now goes up to 2TB on Pro. Pricing: 18 Pro starts at $1,199. 18 Pro Max starts at $1,299. Pre-orders Friday, September 12. In stores September 18.

source_caption_text:
Speed couldn’t believe the new tech in the iPhone 18 😂😂

Apple just announced the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max.

Same design language as last year’s Pros. New colors: black, silver, glacier, and burgundy. Smaller Dynamic Island. A20 Pro chip on 2nm. Apple says the GPU is up to 40% faster than A19 Pro and this is the longest battery life they’ve ever put in an iPhone. Pro Max is the biggest jump.

The real camera change is the 48MP Fusion main with variable aperture , the first time Apple’s given that kind of control on an iPhone. Triple 48MP setup on the back. iOS 27. Storage now goes up to 2TB on Pro.

Pricing: 18 Pro starts at $1,199. 18 Pro Max starts at $1,299. Pre-orders Friday, September 12. In stores September 18.
